title: Admin routes remounted outside the authorization middleware

pr_metadata.title: Move admin endpoints under /api/v2
pr_metadata.body: PathPrefix subrouter cleanup during the API versioning work.

labels.defect: Authorization middleware dropped during the subrouter refactor: admin user-list and role-edit endpoints are now unauthenticated
labels.evidence: Reproducible: GET /api/v2/admin/users with no session (the authz wrapper is absent from both Handle chains) returns the full user list; RequireRole exists in the file but is no longer referenced.

adjudication.notes: Refactor drops RequireRole(admin) from both admin handlers under /api/v2 with no replacement middleware: authorization bypass absent in base.
